To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have successfully fabricated high quality HfAlO gate dielectric with low leakage current and high breakdown voltage by doping Hf with Al at low growth temperature.
the H1A0.5A0.5 HfAlO gate dielectric showed a good fit with Fowler Nordheim tunnnelling, and the H1A2 HfAlO film showed the highest breakdown voltage of 10 V. The

HfAlO gate dielectric with high capacitance and low leakage current can be fabricated at low growth temperature and that the a IGZO TFT with the HfAl O dielectric has good performance and low power consumption.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the low temperature fabrication of Hafnium Aluminium Oxide alloy dielectric using Atomic Layer Deposition and its application in low power devices.
the fabrication and characterization of high quality HfAlO thin films, which are prepared using ALD at low growth temperature and applied to a low power device
the fabrication of a HfAlO gate dielectric using atomic deposition, and the application of the HfAl0 gate dielectric to a low power device.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the HfAl0 alloy dielectric is promising for low temperature processing and low voltage operation of a IGZO TFT.
the low temperature fabrication of H1A1 alloy dielectrics is promising for the development of low power devices.
the 1 cycle each H1A1 dielectric layer, grown by atomic layer deposition at a low temperature of 150 degC, is suitable for the fabrication of low power a IGZO TFT devices.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

HfAlO gate dielectric films with high quality and good performance can be fabricated by ALD and that the HfAl O dielectric is promising for the fabrication of a IGZO TFT devices with high performance and low operating voltage.
the low temperature (150 deg C) HfAlO film is a good candidate for the next generation of gate dielectrics in TFTs.

a high quality HfAlO film can be fabricated by doping Hf2O3 with Al2O3 at a low growth temperature of 150 degC, and the HfAl O alloy gate dielectric is a promising material for the next generation of low power devices.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the low temperature fabrication of H1A1 HfAlO gate dielectric using ALD can provide a promising solution for the fabrication of low power a IGZO TFT devices.
the H1A 1 HfAlO gate dielectric is suitable for the fabrication of low power TFTs.

low temperature HfAlO film with a high breakdown voltage, a low leakage current, a high dielectric constant and a high barrier height can be fabricated by doping HfAlO with Al2O3 using ALD at 150 degC and can be employed as a good candidate gate dielectric in TFTs.
